$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

AbstentionPolicy.description:
How a request's result may be accepted (3.5). Thresholds exist only when
the required result is a distribution; label-only acceptance exists only
when the request permits it explicitly. Neither is a calibration claim.

oneOf.description:
Accept a distribution only if its top mass is at least
`min_top_mass` and the top mass exceeds the second by at least
`min_margin`. Both are in `[0, 1]`.
The request explicitly permits a label with no mass.

ContextField.description:
One named context field (3.2). `provenance` and `source` state who
asserted the value; they do not make it true or trusted (3.3).

source.description: Who asserted it; recorded, never trusted as authority.

source_revision.description: The revision of the source the value was read at.

ContextValue.description:
A scalar or text context value in canonical form (3.2). Decimals are
strings, so a request holds no binary floating-point number.

DynamicOperation.description:
The three dynamic operations (3.2). Their names are R-05's; `rank`,
`generate` and `extract` are not dynamic operations in version 1.

DynamicOutputKind.description:
The output kind a request requires (3.2): `label` for any operation,
`distribution` for `proposition` and `classify`, `ordinal_distribution`
for `rubric`. A distribution is never a calibrated probability, and an
ordinal distribution is never an interval score (3.6).

ProvenanceClass.description: The closed set of provenance classes (spec 002, 3.7.1).

Scope.description: The isolation scope of a capture, a bundle and every request identity.

oneOf.description:
Reuse across principals within one tenant and context revision: an
explicit host assertion that the computation is principal-independent
and that the host authorizes every reader (spec 004, 3.1.4).

Reuse only within one tenant, context revision and effective
principal scope. The default.

TaskFamily.description: A task family and its version, selected from a host allowlist (3.2).

artifact.description: The artifact the backend must declare.

deadline_ms.description:
The end-to-end deadline, from the moment the runtime starts the
request; positive.

labels.description:
The ordered labels (`proposition`, `classify`) or levels, low to
high (`rubric`). Unique by byte-exact comparison.

max_cost_units.description: The hard cost cap of the one attempt; positive.

privacy.description:
The privacy options requested; each must be declared by the
capability. A request is evidence of what was asked, never that the
options were honored.

request_id.description:
Unique per request, 1 to 256 bytes. Not part of the canonical
request identity.

scope.description: The opaque authorized scope: an isolation key, never a grant.
